description:
Track time against threads, billable or not. Each thread's entries are stored in threads/<Kind>/<Name>/hours.md.

Subcommands:
  log THREAD DESCRIPTION [-m MIN] [-r RATE] [-c CODE] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] — append an entry
  list [THREAD] [--since D] [--until D] [--json] — list entries
  report [--thread T] [--since D] [--until D] [--json] — totals by thread and currency; unbilled time totalled separately
  show ID [--json] — show one entry
  edit ID [--description TEXT] [-m MIN] [-r RATE] [-c CODE] [-d DATE] [-t HH:MM] — change fields of an entry
  rm ID -y — permanently delete an entry

Args:
  THREAD       'Kind/Name', name or wikilink
  DESCRIPTION  short invoice line item for the work done; must not be empty
  ID           8-char entry id from `hours list`

Flags:
  log:
    -m, --minutes N      duration; default 60; must be positive
    -r, --rate N         hourly rate; 0 = unbillable; needs a currency
    -c, --currency CODE  ISO code; defaults to the thread's; with neither, the entry is recorded as unbilled
    -d, --date YYYY-MM-DD  default today
    -t, --time HH:MM     start time; default now
  list, report:
    --thread T (report only; for list, give THREAD as a positional), --since YYYY-MM-DD, --until YYYY-MM-DD, --json
  show:
    --json
  edit:
    --description TEXT   new description
    -m, --minutes N      new duration; the start time stays the same
    -r, --rate N         new rate; needs a currency
    -c, --currency CODE  new ISO code
    -d, --date YYYY-MM-DD  move to this day; the duration stays the same
    -t, --time HH:MM     move to this start time; the duration stays the same
  rm:
    -y, --yes            required to confirm

Examples:
  ["log", "Projects/Northwind", "Scope workshop", "-m", "90", "-d", "2026-09-10"]
  ["report", "--thread", "Projects/Northwind", "--since", "2026-09-01", "--json"]
  ["edit", "1a2b3c4d", "-m", "120"]
  ["rm", "1a2b3c4d", "-y"]

Notes:
  Keep DESCRIPTION a short label. It appears on client statements, and `search` does not index it. Record narrative with `buffer add-text`.
  --description consumes every word after it, so put it last.
  `log` adds a REF: line to buffer.md, filed under the entry's date. It reaches the thread's log on the next `buffer flush`.
  Do not hand-edit hours.md. `rm` is permanent.
  Exit 1 means one of: non-positive minutes, a rate with no currency, or an empty description.
